apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

Not programming that. PT banned overhead pressing for rotator cuff tendinopathy — that restriction stands regardless of how your shoulder feels day-to-day; tendinopathy pain is a poor real-time indicator of tissue readiness. See your PT before reintroducing overhead work.

I can add heavy rows, incline press, or landmine press + reach to Wednesday instead — want one of those?
